description: What Xodia knows about a project: the Xodia host it lives on (xodiaHost), how its preview runs (preview), framework, styling, CMS, host, editing tier, the branch the workspace has open, whether that branch is view only on the workspace's plan (branchViewOnly), whether the plan includes timeline motion effects (motionTimeline), the plan's page and CMS limits when it has them (planLimits: pagesPerProject, the pages counted so far, cmsCollections and cmsLimits for Xodia collections, otherCollections for Markdown folders, Decap and connected CMSs, and a note to follow), files changed since the last restore point (unsavedFiles), for a site made with Import a website, imported (its IMPORTED.md, source address and how to edit it), and for a project made with Convert to React, converted (its CONVERTED.md and how to tidy it), and for an imported site, source (where it came from, its stack in short, motion found in its code, and the state, notes and needsUser of Xodia's Tailwind 4 upgrade and import adapter). Call it first on an imported or converted site, and before planning new pages or collections.
name: get_project
title: Get project
